title: Verifiable but Not Predictable: What Sentence Embeddings Know About Propositional Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2611.33668v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quality control for proposition decomposition by large language models (LLMs) raises two asymmetric questions. After decomposition, one can verify: given a sentence and a candidate proposition, does the proposition belong to that sentence? Before decomposition, one would like to predict: how many propositions should the sentence yield? On PropSegmEnt, a corpus of English Wikipedia sentences each segmented by three human annotators, we find that the two questions live in different representational spaces. A natural language inference (NLI) judge verifies membership with 92.8% accuracy and an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.977, and its residual errors turn out to be mostly propositions that are true in document context rather than genuine entailment mistakes. translated_title: 可验证但不可预测：句子嵌入对命题分解究竟了解什么
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.33668v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）命题分解的质量控制提出了两个不对称的问题。分解之后，可以进行验证：给定一个句子和一个候选命题，该命题是否属于该句子？分解之前，人们希望进行预测：这个句子应该产生多少个命题？在PropSegmEnt（一个包含英文维基百科句子、每句均由三位人类标注者进行分割的语料库）上，我们发现这两个问题处于不同的表示空间中。自然语言推理（NLI）评判器可以92.8%的准确率和0.977的ROC曲线下面积（AUC）验证命题的隶属关系，而且其残余错误大多属于在文档上下文中确实为真的命题，而非真正的蕴含错误。向量几何无法完成验证：余弦相似度会达到饱和，句子嵌入也并不是其各命题嵌入的线性组合。而在预测方面，每一个符号……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文以PropSegmEnt语料库为基础，发现命题分解的两个质量控制问题处于不同表示空间：分解后可用NLI评判器高精度验证命题归属（准确率92.8%、AUC达0.977），而分解前无法通过句子嵌入的向量几何预测句子应产出的命题数量。
en_tdlr: Using the PropSegmEnt corpus, this paper shows that proposition decomposition quality control splits into two tasks in different representational spaces—membership can be verified post hoc with a 92.8%-accurate NLI judge (AUC 0.977), while the number of propositions a sentence yields cannot be predicted beforehand from sentence embedding geometry.
